Breadboard model and textures are imported from Grab3D's “Breadboard” CC0 1.0 package.
Model page: https://grab3d.com/models/electronics/breadboard/
Downloaded 2026-11-05. The source package includes its CC0 license in Breadboard_OBJ/LICENSE.txt.

Unity uses the bundled OBJ, MTL and JPEG textures under Breadboard_OBJ/. The source model is 165.1 x 54.45 x 20.6 mm before axis conversion. Visible holes, rails, and a few example components are part of the licensed model. BenchFlow keeps snapping coordinates and electrical connectivity in BreadboardGrid.cs.

Additional workspace meshes are from Grab3D CC0 1.0 packages. Each source folder includes its own LICENSE.txt; the packages are bundled locally with their OBJ, MTL, and textures:

- Workbench: https://grab3d.com/models/tools/workbench/ (downloaded 2026-11-05)
- Resistor assembly: https://grab3d.com/models/electronics/resistor/ (downloaded 2026-11-05)
- LED assembly: https://grab3d.com/models/electronics/led/ (downloaded 2026-11-05)
- Generic controller board: https://grab3d.com/models/electronics/circuit-board/ (downloaded 2026-11-05)

The controller board is an unbranded generic model. It is used as a visual stand-in in this prototype; tutorial pin names and circuit checks describe an Uno-compatible circuit. BenchFlow does not claim this generic mesh is an Arduino Uno product.
